CA.rationale: No attention/allocation condition linked to content is present.

COD.rationale: Content (red coordinates), organization/origin metadata, and a separate status-like origin value are all explicitly reported for the same candidate referent.

A.rationale: No attention/allocation or processing condition is linked to content organization/access.

C.rationale: Multiple explicit named color contents (red/blue) are listed with coordinate sets.

D.rationale: The same candidate referent lists content coordinates and separate origin/status metadata, distinguishing identification from status/organization.

O.rationale: Report states display/grid orientation and explicit origin/representation metadata describing how content is presented/emerged.
